description: A column of sixteen clock divisions, one at the top to sixteen at the bottom; turning a cell on puts that division into the count

params.text: Turns every cell in the column off
Turns the cells on and off at random

inputs.text: Each trigger here advances the count by one step
A trigger here sends the count back to its first step

outputs.text: A trigger whenever the count lands on any of the divisions turned on
A trigger whenever the count lands on exactly one of the divisions turned on

notes: click a cell in the column to put that division into the count, and drag up or down the column to set several at once
neither output fires until at least one cell in the column is turned on

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
